howto.name: Upload your PDF
howto.text: Drop a PDF up to 500 MB.

howto.name: Choose a stamp
howto.text: Preset: APPROVED, CONFIDENTIAL, COPY, DRAFT, FINAL, NOT APPROVED, SAMPLE, VOID. Or custom: your own text.

howto.name: Set opacity and position
howto.text: Opacity 0-1 (default 0.5). Position: top/middle/bottom × left/center/right. Click Apply.

faq.q: Are stamps editable annotations or baked-in?
faq.a: Baked into the page content. They survive copying, printing, and PDF/A conversion. To remove, use Whiteout to cover them.

faq.q: Can I apply a stamp to only specific pages?
faq.a: Yes — pages parameter accepts page ranges like '1-3' or 'all'.
Auto-sized to roughly 60% of page width with the chosen opacity for visibility without obscuring content.
